A good pumping journey starts with the right support.
V3 is a new-generation primary breast pump designed to support moms from the very beginning, bringing together dependable dual-motor performance, personalized comfort, and intelligent control in one everyday system. With strong, steady suction up to 300 mmHg per side and independent control for each side, V3 adapts to the way your body responds. Gentle starts, baby-inspired rhythms, and streamlined hands-free collectors make pumping easier to get into, more comfortable to settle into, and simpler to manage day after day.

HOSPITAL-STRENGTH DUAL-MOTOR POWER
Dual motors deliver strong, consistent suction up to 300 mmHg per side for dependable pumping performance, session after session.

PERSONALIZED COMFORT FOR EACH SIDE
Adjust suction independently on the left and right, while SoftStart gradually ramps to your selected level and DoubleFit™ flanges provide a soft, secure fit. 

EXPERT-GUIDED PUMPING EXPERIENCE
One-tap expert programs pair with baby-inspired suckling patterns to support a more natural, comfortable pumping rhythm with less guesswork. 

INTELLIGENT CONTROL AT A GLANCE
A 1.8-inch color display and app connectivity make it easy to check status, adjust settings, and stay in control throughout each session. 

EASY TO USE, EASY TO CLEAN
3-part wearable collectors simplify setup and cleanup, making everyday pumping easier to fit into your routine.

products.title: Smart Non-WiFi Baby Monitor 5.5-Inch Full HD (BM03 Black)
products.body_html:
The Momcozy 5.5 Inch Full HD Smart Non-WiFi Baby Monitor is a video baby monitor designed for parents who want clear, private, and smarter baby viewing without relying on home WiFi. It includes a dedicated parent unit and a 1080P Full HD baby monitor camera, giving families a secure local connection for everyday nursery check-ins, naps, and overnight monitoring.

 

BM03 Black combines a 5.5 inch Full HD screen, 1080P camera clarity, and a secure FHSS local connection with smart viewing features that make monitoring easier. Auto face focus helps keep your baby’s face easier to see on screen, while 360° pan, 140° tilt, and up to 4x zoom let you adjust the view as your baby moves. Smart sound, motion, cry, cough, and safe-zone notifications help parents notice meaningful changes without constantly watching the screen. Night view, two-way audio, and ENC noise reduction support clearer check-ins day and night.

 

The monitor and camera are made with smooth, durable plastic housing, softly rounded edges, and a clean matte finish. The parent unit feels comfortable to hold, with tactile physical buttons for quick control and a large screen that is easy to read during late-night use.

 

BM03 Black is ideal for parents who want a smart non-WiFi baby monitor, families who prefer a private local connection, and caregivers who need reliable room-to-room monitoring without opening an app. It supports multi-camera viewing and split-screen use, making it suitable for one nursery, siblings, or different rooms in the home.

 

For care, wipe the monitor and camera with a soft, dry cloth. Keep the device away from water, avoid harsh cleaners, and place the camera on a stable surface with a clear view of the baby’s sleep area. Storage card is not included.

• Product Type

    The momcozy baby monitor bm04 is a high-performance momcozy 5 inch dual mode smart baby monitor with 2 camera system. Featuring a premium 1080P camera, it serves as an advanced video baby monitor that bridges the gap between private local viewing and convenient remote monitoring.

  • Core Selling Points

    As a top-tier momcozy dual baby monitor, it allows you to choose between a secure 2.4GHz local connection via the parent unit or a WiFi baby monitor feed via the app when you are on the go. This baby monitor with camera features intelligent AI motion detection that alerts you to risks like a covered face or face-down sleeping, alongside Danger Zone alerts. Its powerful infrared night vision provides sufficient lighting to see your baby's face clearly in the dark when placed within 5 meters of the crib.

    Perfect for tech-savvy parents, multi-child families requiring dual-room viewings, and working parents who want to stay securely connected with their little ones through a smart app.

  • Size & Compatibility

    Features a brilliant 5-inch parent display paired with two 1080P HD cameras. Ensure the camera is mounted at least 0.6m (24 inches) above the crib for optimal focal length, and within 5m (16 feet) horizontally for the best night vision performance.

  • Care Instructions

    Disconnect from power before cleaning. Wipe gently with a dry, lint-free microfiber cloth. Do not use chemical solvents or abrasive cleaners on the screen or camera lenses.

products.title: M5 Smart Wearable Breast Pump – Upgraded with App Control
products.body_html:
Gentle, Breast-Friendly Pumping

Baby mouth-like suction rhythm, skin-friendly silicone, and 30-minute auto stop help make daily pumping feel gentler and more comfortable.

Patented DoubleFit™ Flange for a Better Fit

The exclusive DoubleFit™ flange is made to fit more securely and comfortably, helping reduce slips and tugs while boosting pumping efficiency by 28.2% based on internal user feedback.

Ultra-Light, Hands-Free Freedom

Weighing only 8 oz, M5 Smart fits comfortably in your bra for cord-free, hands-free pumping—so you can move, work, care for baby, or get more done while you pump.

Personalized Pumping with Flexible Suction

With 3 pumping modes and 9 suction levels, M5 Smart lets you adjust each session to your body’s needs, supporting comfortable and efficient milk expression.

Only 4 Parts to Clean

Made with BPA-free, food-grade silicone and PP, M5 Smart keeps cleanup simple with only 4 washable parts. Parts can be sterilized in 3 minutes and are heat safe up to 212°F.

Easier Control from Your Phone

Use the Momcozy app to adjust modes and suction levels, track milk output, and view visual pumping stats by day, week, or month—giving you easier control without reaching into your bra.
